text:
Maya Patel: Hey team — planning a repeatable weekly interactive onboarding office hours for newly onboarded accounts. Goal: 45 min walkthrough + 15 min targeted Q&A. Looking for volunteers to facilitate and hosts for APAC-friendly times. :wave:
Carlos Ruiz: I can take the APAC slot (UTC+8) on Tuesdays 8am SGT. prefer hands-on migration topic.
Priya Shah: I can cover EMEA mornings (0800–1000 UTC) on Wednesdays. Happy to do a mini demo on Dedicated capacity.
Jordan Lee: count me in for the US slot (PDT afternoons). Also, we should invite any accounts flagged as renewal-risk next 90d so CS can surface assist requests.
Maya Patel: Awesome — triage ask: Sam, can you pull a short list of renewal-risk accounts (priority=high) who are <6 weeks post-prod that would benefit?
Sam Chen: on it, will share a CSV by EOD. Also suggest we attach 2 short pre-reads: 'Getting Started Checklist' + 'Migration Gotchas' to the calendar invite.
Ava Gomez: Quick note — for capacity, include a slide on dropdown: Dedicated vs Hosted vs Private and a single-call decision flow. Helps reduce back-and-forth.
Priya Shah: Agenda draft: 1) 5m intros 2) 10m checklist walkthrough 3) 15m demo (migration/rollout) 4) 10m cost/perf tuning with Optimize tips 5) 10m Q&A + next steps. Keep it lean.
Maya Patel: Love it. We should also capture feedback and technical action items in a short form after the session. Proposed form: 3 questions + NPS. Link: https://forms.gle/example (placeholder).
Carlos Ruiz: For hands-on labs, can we reserve a breakout link in Zoom with a pre-warmed Dedicated cluster for one of our demo tenants? Commands to spin up:
```bash
# demo cluster script (internal)
./infra/spawn-demo.sh --pool dedicated --model=gpt-optimized --seq=1024
```
Jordan Lee: tagging OnboardBot to create calendar blocks and rotate facilitator roster. @OnboardBot schedule weekly office-hours 45m + 15m buffer, include pre-reads and feedback form.
OnboardBot: Scheduled: Weekly Office Hours — Tue 00:00 UTC (APAC), Wed 08:30 UTC (EMEA), Thu 22:00 UTC (Americas). Calendar invites sent to facilitators. (reacts with :calendar:)
Sam Chen: shared the renewal-risk CSV: https://internal.redwood/drive/renewal-risk-q1.csv — flagged 8 accounts, recommend we invite 4 to the first two cohorts.
Maya Patel: Great. Action items: 1) Sam — finalize CSV & recommended invites (due today). 2) Priya/Carlos/Jordan — confirm facilitator slots & demo notes (due tomorrow). 3) Ava — slide deck + decision flow (due 48h). 4) OnboardBot — create invites + include pre-reads + feedback link.
Priya Shah: If anyone wants to swap slots, ping here. Also propose a template for post-session follow-up message to customers: short summary, recording, top 3 action items, CS owner contact.
Carlos Ruiz: +1. I'll draft the follow-up template and paste it here for copy/paste into invites.
Maya Patel: Thanks everyone. If no objections, we go live next week. Will post final schedule and cohort assignments once Sam and facilitators confirm. :thumbsup:
